title: Tile blueprint
description: A kind of tile a region is made of (#116): its look and its traits. One file per kind, named after its id, which regions and saves name it by (#802); a region's legend places it by its id. Its traits are rules: changing one changes what the game does, so it adds a file to core/rules_changes/ (the rules version) and rehashes the golden replays, like any rule change.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

symbol.description: What tells the kind apart without its color (#68), drawn on the Survey: one printable ASCII character, so every font has it, and unique among the kinds.

model.description: A decoration drawn on every tile of this kind: a res:// path to a model under assets/.

scale.description: How much larger than the pack made it the model is drawn, in hundredths (150 is 1.5 times; 100 when left out), for a model too small to read from the camera.

reach.description: How many rings of tiles around its own the decoration's crown covers (#232), e.g. a large tree's; 0 when left out.

clearance.description: How much height the crown leaves free beneath it (#232), in hundredths of a tile's radius: every tile its reach covers must fit under it, each as tall as its tallest object, measured from the model. 0 when left out.

harvest.description: What harvesting a tile of this kind gives and leaves (#696): a player next to it, or on it, presses the interact action, and a few ticks later every player in the instance rolls their own on its yield table and the tile turns into its depleted kind, which lasts until the instance is purged (#212). Left out, it can't be harvested.

yields.description: The id of the tile table it drops (a loot table of kind tile, in the loot slice's data/loot_tables/).

becomes.description: The id of its depleted kind, another tile blueprint, which can't be harvested by hand.

takes.description: What can harvest it: bare hands (#696). Gear (#697) and a species' skill (#698) come later.

traits.description: What the kind does in the game.

walkable.description: Whether walkers can stand on it.

hides.description: Whether a wild monster standing on it hides there until a player comes next to it (#202); false when left out.

grazable.description: Whether it's grass a grazing wild monster walks to and eats in its grazing hours (#1203); false when left out.

drinkable.description: Whether it's water a drinking wild monster walks up to and drinks from in its drinking hours (#1203); false when left out.
